project.name: CardDemo
project.description: AWS CardDemo migrated from z/OS COBOL, CICS, VSAM, JCL and BMS to Java 25 and Spring Boot

requireJavaVersion.message: Build with JDK 25 or newer: a lower JDK cannot compile release 25 sources.

requireMavenVersion.message: Requires Apache Maven 3.9.11 or newer. Use ./mvnw to get the pinned version.

requireReleaseDeps.message: No SNAPSHOT dependency may enter a reproducible build.

banDynamicVersions.message: Version ranges, LATEST and RELEASE are banned. Declare an exact version.

banDuplicatePomDependencyVersions.message: A dependency is declared twice. Remove the duplicate so its scope still applies.

requirePluginVersions.message: Every plugin must resolve to an exact version. Pin it in properties.
